prompt: A decoder checks the 'Kraft sum' of the code lengths, the sum of 2^-length over all symbols. 1 means a complete code, above 1 is impossible, below 1 leaves unused bit patterns.
explain: 1/2 + 1/4 + 1/4 = 1. 1/2 + 1/2 + 1/4 = 5/4, more codes than bit patterns exist. 3 x 1/4 = 3/4, so one pattern of two bits is never assigned.
